summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on experience building real time computer vision and ROS2 robotics systems on edge hardware. Delivered a Jetson deployed pick and place system integrating TensorRT optimized YOLO for visual servoing (5.2x speedup, 56.7 to 10.9 ms) and dual time of flight sensor fusion for contact aware grasping, and separately derived full forward kinematics for a UR5e and AL5B arm validated in ROS2 with MoveIt and RViz. Comfortable bridging embedded firmware, sensor integration, and production quality C++/Python across hardware constrained, real time environments.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Built an ADXL345 + Raspberry Pi gesture-recognition glove translating hand motion into HID commands via Bluetooth.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Built a metal surface inspection pipeline for crack analysis using image stitching and depth estimation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) for visual servoing and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance display.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built CARLA data pipelines producing ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.
Validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles/10 pedestrians; achieved zero collisions across multiple laps.
